# edgecenter_websec_resource (Resource)

WebSec resource: a domain under DDoS protection with its subdomains, source group, SSL certificate and protection options. Point the A record of the domain to `protected_ip`. For your own certificate set `ssl_certificate`; for a Let's Encrypt one leave it unset and add `edgecenter_websec_lecert`. An update is refused while `protected_ip` is empty, because the API would move the domain to a new address.

Changing `domain` replaces the resource; every other attribute is updated in place.

Import with `<resource_id>`. `GET <edgecenter_websec_api>/resources` lists the resources with their ids, and `edgecenter_websec_api` defaults to `<api_endpoint>/v2/protection`. A resource moved from the old protection API keeps the id of its `edgecenter_protection_resource`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "edgecenter" {
  permanent_api_token = "251$d3361.............1b35f26d8"
}

variable "certificate" {
  type = string
}

variable "private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_source_group" "example_com" {
  name = "example.com origins"

  source {
    source = "203.0.113.10"
  }

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_ssl_certificate" "example_com" {
  name        = "example.com ${substr(sha256(var.certificate), 0, 8)}"
  certificate = var.certificate
  private_key = var.private_key

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

resource "edgecenter_websec_resource" "example_com" {
  domain          = "example.com"
  subdomains      = ["www.example.com"]
  source_group    = edgecenter_websec_source_group.example_com.id
  ssl_certificate = edgecenter_websec_ssl_certificate.example_com.id

  options {
    tls_versions {
      value = ["TLSv1.2", "TLSv1.3"]
    }

    redirect_http_to_https {
      value = true
    }

    www_redirects {
      value = true
    }

    blacklist {
      value = ["198.51.100.0/24", "2001:db8::/32"]
    }

    country_acl {
      policy_type     = "allow"
      excepted_values = ["KP"]
    }

    response_headers {
      value {
        name  = "X-Frame-Options"
        value = ["DENY"]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name to protect, in lowercase, two levels or more. "*." is allowed as the first label. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `source_group` (Number) ID of the `edgecenter_websec_source_group` the requests go to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Enable or disable the resource. Defaults to `true`.
- `options` (Block List, Max: 1) Protection options of the resource. The resource is created with exactly the options set here: every other option, including the ones this provider does not manage, is sent as null, so no API defaults apply. An update sends only the options that changed, and removing an option block deletes the option. Options this provider does not manage are neither read nor changed after create. An empty `options {}` block is rejected. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options))
- `ssl_certificate` (Number) ID of your own `edgecenter_websec_ssl_certificate`. Leave it unset when the certificate comes from `edgecenter_websec_lecert`: the server links that one itself. A change is refused while an automated certificate is linked: to switch to your own certificate, remove the `edgecenter_websec_lecert` of the resource in the same apply.
- `subdomains` (Set of String) Subdomains of `domain` protected together with it, in lowercase, each ending with `.<domain>`. "*." as the first label needs wildcard subdomains enabled for the account.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `client` (Number) Client ID.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the resource is enabled by the administrator.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `protected_ip` (String) Protected IP address. The A record of `domain` must point to it.
- `ssl_automated` (Boolean) Whether the server issues and renews the certificate of the resource.
- `ssl_certificate_automated` (Boolean) Whether the linked certificate is an automated one, issued by `edgecenter_websec_lecert`.
- `status` (String) Resource status: "processed" after create, "active" once the protection agents report the resource. A resource moved from the old protection API keeps its old status string.

<a id="nestedblock--options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options`

Optional:

- `allowed_http_methods` (Block List, Max: 1) HTTP methods allowed in requests. The methods you can use are set per client and resource, by default "GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE" and "OPTIONS". (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--allowed_http_methods))
- `antibot_flood_challenge` (Block List, Max: 1) Check that a request comes from a browser before passing it on. The check answers with HTTP 307 and sets the antibot cookie. Disabling it on a resource also disables the antibot URL exceptions and user agent whitelist of the resource, which this provider does not manage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--antibot_flood_challenge))
- `asn_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the autonomous system number of the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--asn_acl))
- `blacklist` (Block List, Max: 1) IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and networks denied access to the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--blacklist))
- `country_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the country of the client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--country_acl))
- `ip_hash` (Block List, Max: 1) Send all requests of a client to the same source, chosen by the client IP address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--ip_hash))
- `redirect_http_to_https` (Block List, Max: 1) Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. The resource needs a certificate, `ssl_certificate` or one issued by `edgecenter_websec_lecert`. A Let's Encrypt certificate is issued after the resource is created, so enable the redirect for it in a later apply, and disable the redirect before removing the `edgecenter_websec_lecert`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--redirect_http_to_https))
- `referer_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the Referer header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--referer_acl))
- `response_headers` (Block List, Max: 1) Add headers to the responses. Header names are case insensitive and must be unique. Which names and values the API accepts is set per client. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--response_headers))
- `source_protocol_https` (Block List, Max: 1) Connect to the sources over HTTPS. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--source_protocol_https))
- `tls_versions` (Block List, Max: 1) TLS versions the resource accepts. The versions you can use are set per client, by default "SSLv3", "TLSv1", "TLSv1.1", "TLSv1.2" and "TLSv1.3". Without this block the resource is created with no TLS versions option at all, so set it explicitly. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--tls_versions))
- `user_agent_acl` (Block List, Max: 1) Allow or deny requests by the User-Agent header. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--user_agent_acl))
- `waf` (Block List, Max: 1) Enable the web application firewall. The WAF must be enabled on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--waf))
- `whitelist` (Block List, Max: 1) IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and networks on the whitelist of the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--whitelist))
- `www_redirects` (Block List, Max: 1) Redirect requests from the www subdomain to `domain`. Enabling it needs `www.<domain>` in `subdomains`. Removing that subdomain deletes the option in the API, so remove this block in the same change. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--www_redirects))

<a id="nestedblock--options--allowed_http_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.allowed_http_methods`

Required:

- `value` (Set of String) Allowed HTTP methods.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--antibot_flood_challenge"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.antibot_flood_challenge`

Optional:

- `antibot_challenge_get_only_on` (Boolean) Apply the antibot cookie to GET requests only. Defaults to `false`.
- `antibot_challenge_timelimit` (Number) Lifetime of the antibot cookie in minutes. Defaults to `10`.
- `antibot_challenge_utm_referrer` (Boolean) Keep the UTM parameters of the original request through the challenge redirect. Defaults to `false`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.
- `value` (String) Check type: "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE" checks the browser request, "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE_JS" checks it with a JavaScript file, "ANTIBOT_CHALLENGE_JS_BOX" needs a human interaction. Required when the option is enabled.


<a id="nestedblock--options--asn_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.asn_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of Number) ASNs that are the exceptions from `policy_type`, from 1 to 2147483647. Private 4-byte ASNs above 2147483647 cannot be set.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--blacklist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.blacklist`

Required:

- `value` (Set of String) Addresses and networks. The API stores an address as a network, "1.2.3.4" as "1.2.3.4/32", and both forms are the same value here.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--country_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.country_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes in uppercase that are the exceptions from `policy_type`.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--ip_hash"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.ip_hash`

Required:

- `value` (Boolean) Value of the option.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--redirect_http_to_https"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.redirect_http_to_https`

Required:

- `value` (Boolean) Value of the option.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--referer_acl"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.referer_acl`

Required:

- `excepted_values` (Set of String) Domains, "*.domain" or "domain.*" patterns in lowercase that are the exceptions from `policy_type`. An empty string stands for requests without the Referer header and needs at least one more value.
- `policy_type` (String) Default policy, "allow" or "deny". Requests that match `excepted_values` get the opposite one.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.


<a id="nestedblock--options--response_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.response_headers`

Required:

- `value` (Block List, Min: 1) Headers to add. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--options--response_headers--value))

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable the option. Defaults to `true`.

<a id="nestedblock--options--response_headers--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `options.response_headers.value`

Required:

- `name` (String) Header name.
- `value` (Set of String) Header values.

Optional:

- `always` (Boolean) Add the header to every response, whatever its status code. Defaults to `false`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import edgecenter_websec_resource.example_com 12345
```
